# Small Message

Source: [wiki article 9529](../archive/9529.md); edited 2026-08-27.

Exact pinned API: [Small Message](../../api/actions/small-message.md).

<a id="wiki-9529-n1"></a>

- Small Message has a fixed unmodifiable four-second display time.

<a id="wiki-9529-n2"></a>

- The archive warns that spamming Small Message can remove viewing players from the lobby.

<a id="wiki-9529-n3"></a>

- Messages can show runtime values and execution checkpoints for debugging.
